reason: When neither the event type nor the organizer has a destination calendar, handleNewBooking.ts:1063-1067 sets evt.destinationCalendar to null, so the optional-chained push of teamDestinationCalendars at handleNewBooking.ts:1078 does nothing. createAllCalendarEvents then falls to the else branch at EventManager.ts:384-396, which writes only to the organizer's first connected calendar, so the other hosts' calendars are silently dropped.
